question: Why does the Re40 cylinder Cd differ by 4.1226447% between N64 and N128 (QA tolerance 3%)?
newSolverRunsReason: Work order 60 caps additional runs at 2; both were already used (iteration audit 2026-10-23, grid N144 2026-10-23). This record reanalyses saved data only.

reference.source: Economon AIAA-2018-3111 IV.G (SU2 numerical result, not experiment)

inputs.meshGenerator: scripts/qa-cfd-reference.py mesh_bytes(angular, outer): first radial step pi/N, fixed growth 1.1, last layer clipped at outer radius

isolation.evidence: N64 ITER1200 vs ITER2400 identical (0%); N128 ITER1200 vs ITER2400 differ 0.0000534%; last-100 Cd range < 0.0004%
N64 outer radius 50.5 -> 100.5 m changes Cd by 0.3552%
isolation.contributionToGapPercent: ~0.36 (same order at N128 assumed, not measured)

isolation.evidence: inscribed N-gon perimeter deficit 1-sin(pi/N)/(pi/N): N64 0.0402%, N128 0.0100%

isolation.factor: spatial discretization of the N64 grid
isolation.evidence: N64 error vs reference 5.27%, N128 0.93%, N144 0.64%; nearly all change occurs between N64 and N128

threeGridFit.interpretation: Unphysical order for a 2nd-order MUSCL/FDS scheme: the series is not in the asymptotic range, and grid ratio 128/144 = 1.125 is too small. No valid extrapolated Cd or GCI is claimed.

richardson.assumedOrderNote: Illustrative only; not reference values. For a formal 2nd-order scheme the N64->N128 difference cannot be below 3% unless the N64 error is below ~4%, while N64 already deviates 5.27% from the published value.

gridFamilyDefect.finding: The generator does not produce a geometrically similar refinement family. Only the circumferential count and first wall spacing scale with N; growth 1.1 is fixed, so radial spacing away from the wall barely changes and the clipped last layer varies erratically.
gridFamilyDefect.effectiveRefinementRatio: 2.0 circumferential, ~1.37 radial in the near wake (r~1 m); not a uniform h-refinement, so the N64/N128 pair does not satisfy Richardson assumptions

conclusion: The 4.12% gap is spatial discretization error of the coarse N64 grid (outside the asymptotic range), not iteration error, far-field size, boundary condition or drag integration. The N64 grid already fails the 5% reference check on its own. No code defect justifies changing the solver or the evaluator; the tolerance was not relaxed and no run was skipped.
fixReason: A legitimate fix needs new solver runs on a similar grid family, which exceeds the work-order 60 budget.

proposedNextPlan.grid: Scale growth as 1.1^(64/N) (or fixed layer count proportional to N) so all spacings halve together; outer radius fixed 50.5 m without irregular clipping
proposedNextPlan.series: N128, N256 (and N512 if budget) with ratio 2 for a 3-grid Richardson/GCI
proposedNextPlan.budget: New pre-registered plan required; estimated N256 ~4x N128 cells, ~8-10 min single thread, RSS < 200 MB (estimate, not measured)
proposedNextPlan.acceptance: Unchanged: Cd ref 5%, mesh difference 3%, residuals <= -6 all columns, last-100 range 0.5%
